description.value: Todak Todak is a Korean fried chicken and street food restaurant on Kingsway in Vancouver, serving boneless fried chicken, Korean pancakes, fish cake soup, and oden soup. The restaurant markets itself as using fresh, quality ingredients and has recently undergone renovations. Online ordering is available, and the menu spans a range of Korean street food classics alongside refreshing drinks.
